TBD-R08.value: In tranche 1, no class has the most primary units in both raters' codes and after reconciliation: of 18 units 12 are undetermined, and the 6 determined ones split V 2, G 1, X 3, EG 0 (all in Arm A; the 10 Arm B units are undetermined for lack of a clock anchor). In the ER-2 pilots, no class has the most primary units in both raters' codes and after reconciliation: of 33 units 13 are undetermined and the 20 determined ones split V 5, G 7, X 8, EG 0. In the November takes (4 units), the 2 determined units are both decision codes (V4) and 2 are undetermined; with four units this is not a finding about a dominant class.
